createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime with trailing Z when this profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC datetime with trailing Z when this profile was last updated.

identifiers.description: Optional external identifiers from GND, VIAF, Wikidata, or Open Library.

main.description: An optional sibling profile for anyone credited on a book, published to the person's own PDS as a singleton record. Holds only the delta beyond the base actor profile — external identifiers from authority sources. Carries no name of its own; the display name always comes from the base social.dracome.actor.profile on the same identity.
